qualification: Authoring source and comparator checks only; independent scholarly review and reader testing have not occurred.
source_reading: Every selected original verse and its notes read before independent composition.
findings: Read all 88 original records and their annotations before independently drafting all 88 public verses; read all 88 TSW comparators afterward. Focused authoring reread covered 44 public verses.

Kept Solomon’s request for wisdom connected with governing the people. Retained the going-out/coming-in image with explanation, and noted the difficult direction wording at 1:13 and the Kue interpretation at 1:16.

Preserved the 153,600 resident foreigners assigned to the work and the exact seventy-thousand/eighty-thousand/thirty-six-hundred division. The draft does not turn the assigned labor into an assertion of voluntary participation.
Retained Dan for the craftsman’s mother, Huram-abi, the twenty-thousand-unit provisions and the uncertain timber identification rather than importing details from Kings.

The Hebrew height of the bronze altar at 4:1 is ten cubits; the TSW comparator incorrectly says twenty. Fluent retains the Hebrew ten. The hundred-twenty-cubit hall height in 3:4 is retained with a textual note about the twenty-cubit reading in some witnesses.

Kept thirty-five cubits for the two pillars without inserting each, the sixty-by-twenty foundation dimensions, five-cubit wings and capitals, and the Sea’s three-thousand-bath capacity. Did not harmonize these with Kings.
Kept oxen at 4:3 and the inner-sanctuary chain wording at 3:16 with notes on their difficulty. Retained from the ark and the singular it at 5:9, and Levitical priests at 5:5.
Preserved the hundred twenty trumpeting priests, as one/one sound repetition, and the faithful-love refrain joining the worship scene to earlier thanksgiving.
Public 2:1 binds original 1:18; public 2:2–18 binds original 2:1–17. All other selected labels match; each original record is bound once.
Reviewed all ten high-overlap verses. Clear dimensions, dates and formulas were retained where useful. Overlap did not govern translation decisions.
overlap_qualification: NFKC/casefold whole-verse word overlap is triage, not proof of fidelity, originality, legal uniqueness or comprehension. No change quota.
companion_impact: Changed wording invalidates earlier quote/text bindings for these chapters; reconcile during later Companion installation. No Companion files changed.
remaining_work: Whole-book Samuel, Kings and 1 Chronicles authoring consistency passes remain queued; independent editorial review and reader testing remain pending.
